catalog_quirks.body: Router9 Free grants 10,000 credits (about $1) per monthly billing period, shared across API keys and Studio usage. The allowance renews on the account signup anniversary, not necessarily the first of the month, and unused credits do not roll over. Paid prepaid overage is outside the free allowance. Verified against current provider documentation November 3, 2026. https://www.router9.com/docs/token-plan/credits
catalog_quirks.title: Shared monthly free credits
